name: RefreshCustomerAggregates
description: Calc layer (6b): computes the ledger balance columns on Customers from OpenMovements (openBalance, openDebit, onAccountCredit = קבלה movements, overdueAmount = positive movements with dueDate before asOf, oldestDueDate, openMovementCount) and documentCount / lastDocumentDate from Invoices, plus aggregatesAt. asOf = AgentSettings balanceAsOfDate, empty = today. Customers whose ledger was never read (movementsSyncedAt empty) keep the ledger columns null. Works in batches; only changed rows are written, then read back. Called by PullOpenMovements (real run, completed customers) and SyncFromBrain (real run, async). dryRun (default true) only reports. Never writes to Priority.
